canvasEmptySelectionHint: Select a node to edit it, or add one from the palette. Wire a source into a condition, and the condition's signal into an action.
canvasErrorInvalidJson: The rule definition is not valid JSON.
canvasErrorNotRuleObject: The rule definition is not a rule object.
canvasErrorUnsupportedType: This rule type ({{type}}) cannot be shown on the canvas.
canvasFidelityChecking: Checking that the canvas can show this rule in full…
canvasFidelityLossy: This rule has settings the canvas cannot show, so only part of it is on the canvas. Saving from here would drop the rest, so saving is turned off. Edit this rule through the API. The Form can open it too, but it warns that saving there would drop what it cannot show.
canvasFidelityRelaid: This rule was changed outside the canvas, so its saved layout no longer matched. The canvas has laid it out again from the rule itself; saving here keeps the current rule.
canvasFidelityStaleLayout: This rule was changed outside the canvas, and its saved canvas no longer matches it. The canvas cannot lay out the current rule in full, so saving here would undo that change. Saving is turned off. Edit this rule through the API.
canvasFidelityUncompilable: The rule as laid out on the canvas does not compile, so the canvas cannot confirm that saving here would keep it intact. Saving is turned off. Edit this rule in the Form.
canvasFidelityUncompilableGraph: This rule's saved canvas does not compile as it stands. Fix it here: saving replaces the stored rule with what is on the canvas, including undoing any change made to the rule outside the canvas since it was last saved here.
canvasFidelityUnrepresentable: {{reason}} Saving from the canvas would replace it, so saving is turned off here. Edit this rule through the API.
canvasFidelityUnverified: The canvas could not reach the compiler to confirm it shows this rule in full, so saving is turned off.
canvasFixCompileErrors: Fix the compile errors before previewing
canvasScopedToGroup: Scoped to group <mono>{{token}}@{{version}}</mono> — preserved on save; edit the scope in the Form tab.
canvasTokenDescription: The rule id; it cannot change.
defCommandDescription: The commands a device accepts, with their optional parameter schema.
defCommandKeyHint: The command a device accepts, e.g. set_point.
defDetectionRuleDescription: Rules that raise alarms and send commands off this profile's telemetry. Author them step by step in the Form, or visually on the Canvas — both compile to the same rule.
defDetectionRuleEmptyHint: Use “New detection rule” to add one.
defMetricDescription: The typed, unit-bearing measurements a device reports.
defMetricKeyHint: The key measurements carry, e.g. temperature.
defParamSchemaHint: Optional JSON array of parameters, each { "name", "dataType", … }. Leave blank for a no-argument command.
healthEmpty: No published detection rules. Author rules in the Detection Rules tab and publish the profile.
healthFeedEmpty: Waiting for detections… firings appear here as rules trigger.
healthIntro: Per-rule health for this profile's active published version. A rule fires against live telemetry only after the profile is published. Fire counts and last-fired times are approximate: they are written in the background, so they can lag by a few seconds, and they can miss fires while the database is struggling. The last signal is the latest the counters saw, not the rule's current alarm state.
inspectorAlarmKeyDescription: Repeated firings escalate one alarm keyed on this. Empty ⇒ the rule's token.
inspectorAlarmKeyTemplateDescription: Renders the alarm key for each detection. Set through the API; the canvas keeps it on save but does not edit it.
inspectorAnchorTypeDescription: The area/anchor devices roll up to (e.g. zone).
inspectorBodyCelDescription: A CEL expression over the detection (value / hasValue / series) evaluating to the request body string. Empty ⇒ no body.
inspectorBranchHelp: Use decimal literals (<gt100>value > 100.0</gt100>, not <oneHundred>100</oneHundred>). <valueWord>value</valueWord> is the triggering reading — it is absent for conditions that carry no scalar (absence, duration, and metric-less or raw-CEL leaves), so guard those with <hasValueWord>hasValue</hasValueWord> (e.g. <hasValueExpr>hasValue && value > 100.0</hasValueExpr>). The branch never blocks an alarm from clearing.
inspectorBranchLabelDescription: An optional name for this route (authoring only).
inspectorCelExpressionDescription: An advanced predicate over the event vocabulary. Cost-gated at compile.
inspectorComputeHelp: Wire this into a condition's or branch's <valuePort>value</valuePort> port, then reference it by name in that node's CEL (e.g. <tempFExample>tempF > 100.0</tempFExample>). It reads the vocabulary of whatever it feeds — the event's <mWord>m</mWord>/<attrWord>attr</attrWord> for a condition leaf, the detection's <valueWord>value</valueWord>/<hasValueWord>hasValue</hasValueWord>/<seriesWord>series</seriesWord> for a branch. Use decimal literals; a computed value can only feed a <celWord>CEL</celWord> predicate, not a structured metric·op·threshold leaf.
inspectorComputeNameDescription: The identifier the condition or branch references this value by. Letters, digits, underscore; not starting with a digit.
inspectorComputeValueCelDescription: A single expression the compiler folds into the predicate it feeds. Cost-gated at compile.
inspectorConnectivityHelp: Fires the moment a device reports a disconnect, and clears when it reconnects. There is nothing to configure: the connection change is the whole signal. It needs a transport that reports connects and disconnects.
inspectorConnectorDescription: The registered connector to publish through. Manage connectors under Connectors.
inspectorExpiresAfterDescription: Optional. How long the command may wait for a device to take it, such as 15m or 2h (1 minute to 7 days). Empty uses the platform default of 7 days.
inspectorHeadersDescription: Optional static headers, one “Key: Value” per line. Authorization / X-DC-* are reserved and rejected at publish.
connectorsLoadError: The connector list could not be loaded: {{message}}
inspectorNoConnectorsHint: No connectors yet. Create one under <link>Connectors</link>, then pick it here.
inspectorOnlyWhenCelDescription: A boolean over the detection: value, hasValue, series. Downstream actions run only when it holds. Cost-gated at compile.
inspectorPayloadCelDescription: A CEL expression over the detection evaluating to the message body string. Empty ⇒ an empty payload.
inspectorSecretHandleDescription: Optional. The name of a stored secret presented as the auth header at dispatch. Never the cleartext value.
inspectorSeverityDescription: Required when this rule raises an alarm.
inspectorSourceScopedTo: Scoped to profile <mono>{{token}}</mono>. Every rule reads this profile's telemetry.
inspectorUrlDescription: An http/https endpoint. POST only. Delivered by the outbound-connectors service.
nlDraftFailedMessage_one: The draft didn’t compile after {{count}} attempt. Refine your description and try again.
nlDraftFailedMessage_other: The draft didn’t compile after {{count}} attempts. Refine your description and try again.
nlFooterNote: The AI proposes; the compiler decides. Nothing is saved until you do.
nlHelpText: Describe the rule in plain language. AI drafts it and the compiler checks it; you review and save the result through the form.
nlNoDefinitionError: The draft compiled but returned no definition. Please try again.
nlPlaceholder: e.g. Raise a major alarm when the case temperature stays above 80°C for 5 minutes
nlUnavailableDefaultReason: Natural-language drafting is not available — no inference provider is enabled for this tenant.
previewDescription: Replays this profile's published history and shows the raise/resolve edges this draft would have produced — nothing is published.
previewCalculatedSkips_one: {{count}} draft formula result produced no value.
previewCalculatedSkips_other: {{count}} draft formula results produced no value.
previewRecalculated_one: Calculated metrics recomputed with the draft profile's formulas for {{count}} reading.
previewRecalculated_other: Calculated metrics recomputed with the draft profile's formulas for {{count}} readings.
previewSelectFiringHint: Select a firing to trace its path on the canvas.
profileCategoryHint: Functional device class, e.g. thermostat, meter, gateway. Suggests categories already in use; you can type a new one.
profileTokenLockedHint: The profile id; it cannot change.
ruleActionGuardNote: Runs only when <mono>{{guard}}</mono> — a branch condition authored on the Canvas. It is preserved here; switch to the Canvas to change or remove it.
ruleActionTimeoutDescription: Optional. How long the call may take, in milliseconds (at most {{max}}). Empty uses the default.
ruleActionsForbiddenNote: An area-correlation rule cannot carry actions — its series is an area anchor, not a device.
ruleActionsSectionDescription: What happens when the rule fires. No action ⇒ it emits a subscribe-able signal only.
ruleAlarmKeyDescription: Optional. Repeated firings escalate one alarm keyed here; blank ⇒ the rule's token.
ruleAnchorTypeDescription: The anchor (area) relationship distinct devices roll up to.
ruleBoundDescription: A fixed value, or the device's own attribute.
ruleCelDescription: An advanced predicate over the event vocabulary: m, attr, device, anchors, occurred, geo. Geofence containment is written geo.inFence("fence-token"). Type-checked and cost-gated at publish.
ruleCommandDescription: The command key on this profile.
ruleConditionDescriptionOptional: An optional per-event gate. “Match every event” lets the temporal shape carry the logic.
ruleConditionDescriptionRequired: The comparison this rule fires on.
ruleCountDescriptionAggregate: The number of events per count window.
ruleCountDescriptionCorrelation: The number of distinct devices that must report within the window.
ruleCountDescriptionRepeating: The number of matching events within the window.
ruleDescriptionPlaceholder: What this rule detects and why.
ruleEnabledCheckboxLabel: Enabled — a disabled rule is kept with the profile but not run.
ruleHintAggCount: A count-window aggregate needs a positive count.
ruleHintAggGap: A session aggregate needs a gap.
ruleHintAggMetric: This aggregate needs a value metric.
ruleHintAggThreshold: The aggregate needs a numeric threshold.
ruleHintConditionRequired: This rule type requires a condition.
ruleHintConditionThreshold: The condition needs a numeric threshold value.
ruleHintConditionThresholdAttr: The condition needs a threshold attribute.
ruleHintCorrCount: Correlation needs a positive distinct-device count.
ruleHintRaiseAlarmSeverity: A raise-alarm action requires a severity.
ruleHintRepeatingCount: Repeating needs a positive occurrence count.
ruleHintConnectorRequired: A publish action needs a connector. Pick one, or create it under Connectors first.
ruleHintHeaderMalformed: A webhook header must be written “Key: Value” — this line is not: {{line}}
ruleHintHttpUrlRequired: A webhook action needs a URL.
ruleHintHttpUrlCredentials: The webhook URL must not carry a user name or password. Put the credential in the secret store and name it under Secret handle.
ruleHintHttpUrlScheme: The webhook URL must start with http:// or https:// followed by a host name with no spaces.
ruleHintSecretHandleInvalid: The secret handle may only use letters, digits and - _ / ., must not start with “/”, and may not have empty or “.” segments (at most 256 characters).
ruleHintSendCommandNeedsCommand: A send-command action needs a command.
ruleHintTimeoutRange: The action timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds between 0 and {{max}}.
ruleLossyOpenWarning: This form cannot express everything this rule's stored definition says, so part of it is not shown. Saving from here would replace the original with only what you can see, and asks you to confirm first.
ruleLossySaveDescription: This form cannot carry everything in the rule's stored definition. Saving replaces the stored definition with what the form shows, and the rest is removed.
ruleLossySaveTitle: Save and lose part of this rule?
ruleMemberCapDescription: Optional retained-member backstop; defaults to the platform limit.
ruleMetricDescription: The metric key the event carries.
ruleNameDescription: A human name for the rule.
rulePayloadDescription: Optional JSON object of arguments, stored verbatim.
ruleRateCheckboxLabel: Per-second rate (otherwise the raw delta between samples).
ruleScopeCheckboxLabel: Scope to an entity group — fire this rule only for members of a group version.
ruleScopeGroupDescription: A dynamic entity group. Members are resolved from the group version's frozen selector.
ruleScopeHalfSetHint: Pick a published version for the scoped group.
ruleScopeNoPublishedVersion: This group has no published version yet — publish the group before scoping a rule to it.
ruleScopeUnsupportedKind: A group scope is not supported on a {{ruleType}} rule — publishing will be refused. Absence and correlation rules cannot be group-scoped.
ruleScopeVersionDescription: The rule pins a specific published version, so its target set never drifts under a later group edit.
ruleScopeVersionsLoadError: Could not load this group's versions — check your connection and try again.
ruleSeverityDescriptionRequired: Required — the tier a raised alarm carries.
ruleThresholdAttrDescription: The device attribute whose numeric value is the bound, e.g. tempLimit.
ruleTypeAbsenceDescription: Fires when a device goes silent for a window.
ruleTypeAggregateDescription: Fires when an aggregate over a window crosses a bound.
ruleTypeConnectivityDescription: Fires the moment a device disconnects, and clears when it reconnects.
ruleTypeCorrelationDescription: Fires when distinct devices report under one anchor.
ruleTypeDeltaRateDescription: Fires on the change between consecutive samples.
ruleTypeDurationDescription: Fires when a comparison stays true for a sustained time.
ruleTypeRepeatingDescription: Fires when N matching events fall inside a window.
ruleTypeThresholdDescription: Fires while a metric compares past a bound.
ruleUnmodelledType: This rule's type ("{{type}}") can't be edited in the form. The form does not know this kind of rule, and showing it as another kind would change what it does. The stored rule is left exactly as it is; edit it through the API.
ruleUnmodelledTypeMissing: This rule has no recognisable type, so it can't be edited in the form. Showing it as a particular kind would change what it does. The stored rule is left exactly as it is; edit it through the API.
ruleUnmodelledTypeDraft: This draft's rule type ("{{type}}") can't be edited in the form. The form does not know this kind of rule, and showing it as another kind would change what it does. Nothing has been saved. Describe the rule again, or build it on the canvas.
ruleUnmodelledTypeMissingDraft: This draft has no recognisable type, so it can't be edited in the form. Nothing has been saved. Describe the rule again, or build it on the canvas.
ruleUnparseableWarningDraft: This draft can't be read as a rule, so it can't be edited in the form. Nothing has been saved. Describe the rule again, or build it on the canvas.
ruleUnparseableWarning: This rule's stored definition can't be read as a rule, so it can't be edited in the form. The stored definition is left exactly as it is; edit it through the API.
ruleValueMetricDescriptionAgg: The metric folded by the aggregate.
ruleValueMetricDescriptionDelta: The metric whose change is measured.
ruleWarning.negatedAttributeGuard: This condition tests that the attribute “{{p0}}” is NOT set, so the rule applies to every device without it — including devices where it was never set, was set to something other than a number, or was set with CLIENT scope. If you meant only the devices configured without it, add another test that says so.
ruleWarning.negatedAttributeGuardDisjunc: This condition is true whenever the attribute “{{p0}}” is NOT set, whatever the reading, so it fires for every device without it and no threshold applies to them — including devices where it was never set, was set to something other than a number, or was set with CLIENT scope. If you meant a fallback limit, use a conditional: "t" in m && ("{{p0}}" in attr ? m["t"] > attr["{{p0}}"] : m["t"] > 80.0).
ruleWindowModeCountDescription: A window of N events, not time.
ruleWindowModeSessionDescription: Closes after a gap of silence.
ruleWindowModeSlidingDescription: Trailing time window, re-evaluated per event.
versionNotPublished: Not published yet — devices resolve nothing on this profile until you publish.
versionPublishDrawerDescription: Freeze the current draft into a new version and make it the version devices resolve.
versionPublishExplain: Publishing snapshots the current draft — all metrics, commands, detection rules, and the configuration and position declarations — into a new version. Devices resolve the active version, so draft edits take effect only when published.
versionRollbackConfirm: Make version {{version}} the active version devices resolve? The draft is unchanged.
versionUsedByWarning: Used by {{count}} device types — publishing changes what all of them resolve.
cfgDescription: The shared attribute keys a device of this profile can see as its configuration. A device sees only the declared keys; with none declared it sees an empty document. Edits change the draft and reach devices when the profile is published.
cfgDeleteConfirm: Remove “{{key}}” from the declaration? Devices of this profile stop seeing it once the profile is published.
cfgEmpty: No configuration keys declared, so devices see an empty document.
cfgKeyHint: A shared attribute key, e.g. sampleIntervalSeconds. Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
cfgKeyInvalid: The key must use letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only, and start with a letter or digit.
cfgKeyTooLong: The key may be at most {{max}} characters.
cfgDescriptionTooLong: The description may be at most {{max}} characters.
cfgTooManyKeys: A profile can declare at most {{max}} keys.
cfgTypeHint: How the value is typed in the document the device receives.
lwm2mCommandsDescription: For LwM2M devices: declare Reboot and Read device information as named commands, so they can be picked and sent without typing an object path. Commands already declared are left as they are.
lwm2mCommandsAdded_one: Added {{count}} LwM2M command. Publish the profile for devices to accept it.
lwm2mCommandsAdded_other: Added {{count}} LwM2M commands. Publish the profile for devices to accept them.
lwm2mCommandsAlreadyDeclared: Both LwM2M commands are already declared.
thingModelDownloadLabel: Download version {{version}} as a W3C Web of Things Thing Model
thingModelFailed: Version {{version}} could not be exported as a Thing Model.
presetPickerHelp: Pick a common alert to pre-fill the form below. Nothing is saved until you create the rule, and every field stays editable.
presetDeviceSilentDescription: Raises an alarm when a device in this profile stops reporting for 15 minutes.
presetDeviceSilentHelp: Fires when a device sends nothing for {{timeout}} and resolves when it reports again. It covers every device on the profile; a silence rule cannot be limited to a device group.
presetHeldThresholdDescription: Raises an alarm when a metric stays above a limit for 10 minutes.
presetHeldThresholdHelp: Fires when the metric stays above your limit continuously for {{hold}}. Choose the metric and the limit; switch the operator for a below-limit alert.
presetLowBatteryDescription: Raises an alarm when the battery level stays below 20% for 10 minutes.
presetLowBatteryHelp: Fires when the battery level stays below {{below}} for {{hold}}. The alarm clears as soon as the level rises back above the limit, so a level hovering at the limit can raise and clear repeatedly.
presetConfirmMetric: Check the metric before creating the rule: it was matched by name or left empty, never assumed.
previewCompleteRule: Complete the rule to preview it.
coverageUnknown: Could not check notification policies. You may not have access to them.
coverageCovered: Covered: an enabled policy sends {{severity}} alarms through a working channel.
coverageUncovered: Not covered: no enabled policy sends {{severity}} alarms anywhere. This rule will raise alarms, but nobody will be notified.
coverageCreateHelp: Policies route by severity, not by rule. This policy will send every {{severity}} alarm in the tenant, from any rule, through the channel you pick.
coverageNoChannels: There is no delivery channel yet. Create an email or webhook channel first (see the notification channels guide), then come back.
defImpactHint: Disruptive and destructive commands wait for the device type's maintenance window; normal commands are never held.
formulaChainHint: Each is computed first, from the sample below, by its own formula; a chain may be at most {{max}} calculated metrics deep. If one of them produces no value, a formula that reads it without checking has() produces none either.
formulaChainTitle: Calculated metrics this formula builds on
formulaCheckFailed: The formula could not be checked: {{message}}
formulaConstantsHint: These come from each device's metadata when a reading arrives: a JSON number under the same name. A device without one, or with something that is not a number, gets no value for that reading. Nothing is stored.
formulaHint: A formula over the metrics of this profile, measured or calculated, such as voltage * current / 1000, and optionally over numbers a device carries in its metadata, such as voltage * device.calibration. At most {{max}} bytes. It is checked as you type and again when the profile is published.
formulaHistoryCaveat: Previewed from stored {{places}}-decimal inputs. The value stored for a reading is computed from the device's full-precision value when the reading arrives, so the two can differ.
formulaHistoryConstants: Uses this device's current metadata for {{names}}, for every sample: not the values it had when each reading was recorded.
formulaHistoryEmpty: No readings of this formula's inputs in this window.
formulaHistoryHint: Run this formula over a device's stored readings. Nothing is stored.
formulaHistoryTooMany: This window holds too many readings to preview (at most {{max}} samples). Choose a shorter window.
formulaSampleHint: Type a value for each metric the formula reads to see what it would produce. Nothing is stored.
formulaSkip.missing_input: an input or device constant the formula reads is missing
formulaSkip.invalid_input: an input or device constant is not a valid value (a device constant must be a number)
formulaSkip.non_finite: a number in the formula is not finite (for example a division by zero)
formulaSkip.div_zero: integer division or remainder by zero
formulaSkip.range: the result is outside this metric’s minimum and maximum
formulaSkip.unstorable: the result is too large to be stored (1e12 or more)
formulaSkip.eval_error: the formula failed to evaluate for this sample
formulaTooLong: The formula is longer than {{max}} bytes.
metricCalculatedBadgeTitle: Computed from a formula when each reading arrives; devices do not report it.
metricKindHint: A measured metric is reported by devices. A calculated metric is computed from a formula over the measured ones and over other calculated metrics. This cannot be changed after the metric is created.
metricKindLockedHint: Fixed when the metric was created. To change it, delete the metric and create a new one.
backfillStartsAtActivation: A calculated metric starts being computed when the version that defines it is published; readings stored before that have no value for it. A backfill computes it for those stored readings and only adds values where there are none. It does not change latest values and raises no alarms.
backfillNeedsVersion: Publish a version first: a backfill fills the calculated metrics of a published version.
backfillNoCalculated: This version has no calculated metrics to fill.
backfillUnavailable: Backfill is not available right now: {{reason}}
backfillDescription: Compute calculated metrics for readings that are already stored. Values that exist are kept; only missing ones are added.
backfillMetricsHint: Metrics new in the chosen version are selected. A metric whose formula changed can also be filled, but then older readings get this version's formula while readings already stored keep theirs.
backfillMetricChanged: The formula changed since an earlier version. Filling it adds values with this version's formula for readings that have none; readings stored under the older formula keep theirs.
backfillRangeHint: Readings in this range are filled. At most {{days}} days per backfill; by default the 30 days before the version became active. Readings older than the device itself, or older than the retention period, are not filled.
backfillRangeProblem.invalid: Enter both a start and an end.
backfillRangeProblem.order: The start must be before the end.
backfillRangeProblem.future: The end cannot be in the future.
backfillRangeProblem.span: A backfill covers at most {{days}} days. Choose a shorter range and run another for the rest.
backfillDevicesHint: Device tokens separated by commas or new lines, at most {{max}}. Leave empty to fill every device of this profile.
backfillTooManyDevices: At most {{max}} devices can be named. Leave the list empty to fill every device.
backfillTryOneHint: Run the backfill on a single device and check its chart before filling the rest. It is safe to repeat: existing values are never changed.
backfillSamplesPresent: {{samples}} readings looked at, {{present}} already had a value
backfillBeyondRetention: {{count}} stretches skipped because retention may remove them
backfillSkip.missing_input: an input or device constant is missing
backfillSkip.invalid_input: an input or device constant is not a valid value
backfillSkip.non_finite: a number in the formula is not finite
backfillSkip.div_zero: integer division or remainder by zero
backfillSkip.range: the result is outside the metric's minimum and maximum
backfillSkip.unstorable: the result is too large to be stored
backfillSkip.ambiguous: the reading holds an input twice with different values, so no single value could be chosen
backfillCancelConfirm: Cancel backfill {{token}}? Values already written stay.
backfillPromptTitle: Fill history for the new metric?
backfillPromptBody_one: This version adds a calculated metric ({{keys}}). Readings stored before it was published have no value for it. Fill them now?
backfillPromptBody_other: This version adds {{count}} calculated metrics ({{keys}}). Readings stored before it was published have no value for them. Fill them now?
calcHealthIntro: Counted from stored readings. A calculated value is stored like any reading, so this compares how many values were stored for each metric with how many readings its inputs have. Counts are by when the reading occurred and reach back as far as your measurement retention.
calcHealthSince: Counted from stored readings since version {{version}} became active ({{when}}).
calcHealthNoActivation: Counted from stored readings. No activation time is recorded for version {{version}} (it was activated before activations were logged), so the counts are not limited to the time it has been active and may include readings from before it.
calcHealthInputsUnknown: This formula no longer compiles against the profile's current definitions, so its inputs cannot be read. Publish or fix the draft to see its counts.
calcHealthShared: Another profile also declares a metric named {{key}}, so these counts include its readings and cannot show this formula is working. Use Why? on a device of this profile.
calcHealthWhyDescription: Run the formula over one device's stored readings to see the reasons it produced no value. Pick a device that reports the formula's inputs.
